highlights: End-to-End Platform Ownership: Architected, managed, and scaled a mission-critical enterprise auditing application end-to-end for a leading American healthcare Pharma giant, ensuring high availability, compliance, and reliability for over 100,000 active users.

Research and Development: Partnered directly with client stakeholders and product teams to design and deliver proof-of-concepts (PoCs), automating complex audit reconciliation and anomaly detection processes.

Cloud Infrastructure & Optimization: Spearheaded cloud-native infrastructure operations and microservices governance across multi-cloud environments, driving continuous performance tuning, security hardening, and system observability.
Learning and Team Building: Organized and led training sessions on cloud, AI, Agentic technologies and infrastructure design, successfully upskilling resources across verticals.

Research and Development Role: Contributed to the planning, design, and architecture of a server-based Cloud Native Serverless Architecture for an American multinational corporation, successfully supporting a user base of 100,000 users.

Design and Development: Spearheaded the architectural transition from a monolithic framework to microservices across AWS, Azure, and GCP, which improved API latency by 26%. Led and documented the development of internal client tools utilizing services such as AWS Bedrock, Vertex AI, and Looker Studio.
Learning and Team Building: Organized and led training sessions on cloud technologies and infrastructure design, successfully upskilling a 12-person development team.
